outcome: Association between epilepsy and MS with major obstetric outcomes
cohort: 909,065 pregnancies in women continuously enrolled in the 2011-2014 Truven Health MarketScan R Commercial Claims Dataset from 270 days before their delivery date.
finding: Ascertainment of epilepsy and MS in delivery hospitalization records underestimated prevalence, but the window of recording generally did not impact risk ratio estimates of associations with obstetric outcomes.
